answer_1.quote: Mathematical reasoning stands as a crucial testament to the development of artificial intelligence. It requires rigorous problem understanding, strategy formulating, and calculation performing abilities.
answer_1.outputs: Generated solutions to math word problems with step-by-step reasoning and final numerical answers

answer_2.quote: We adopt the performance drop rate (PDR) metric to measure the relative performance decline on question variations compared to the performance on initial questions.

answer_4.quote: We utilize the Tencent crowdsource platform for selecting three qualified human annotators to evaluate human performance on math reasoning.
answer_4.guideline: Each human annotator is required to have a track record of completing over 1,000 HIT tasks and must successfully pass a qualification exam consisting of 9 questions before commencing the problem-solving annotation.
